WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT powerstatus,
         telescope_count,
         1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.average_share) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM status_shares AS s
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE s.share > a.average_share;
